autosaveIdleSeconds.title: Autosave after idle (seconds)
autosaveIdleSeconds.description: A file tab saves this long after you stop typing. 0 turns idle autosave off (Ctrl+S still saves). When Claude changed the file meanwhile, the editor merges first.

autosaveOnBlur.title: Autosave on focus loss
autosaveOnBlur.description: A file tab saves when you leave it (another tab, another window).

autosaveSeconds.title: Autosave (seconds)
autosaveSeconds.description: micro saves the file this often while you edit. 0 turns autosave off. micro asks before reloading a file that changed on disk (Claude may be writing it too).

colorscheme.title: Colour scheme
colorscheme.description: A micro colorscheme name (e.g. dracula-tc, gruvbox-tc, solarized-tc, default); empty uses your micro settings.

microPath.title: micro command
microPath.description: The micro binary: a name looked up on your login-shell PATH, or an absolute path.

cli.name: edit
cli.summary: Edit a file of this project in micro, in an overlay
